predictions.quote: It's almost crazy that each of us has like a Turing... if you were to chat with an agent now it feels like the Turing test will be complete, it's as smart as another human. And we hope this year we'll do that same thing for voice, where any conversation feels like you are speaking with another human.
predictions.prediction: Voice AI will reach a point this year where any conversation with an AI voice agent feels indistinguishable from speaking with another human.
